verdict.rationale: Deepgram's dg CLI ships a built-in, first-party MCP server that gives AI coding tools direct access to Deepgram APIs, and a probe confirms a dedicated official MCP server docs page exists. So an agent can connect via an official MCP server. Missing for 10: details on the exposed tools and scope, client setup and configuration instructions, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works.
